audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed across layers on all seven rows: phases[N].side read Azir/Azir/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Azir while content win[N] and the packet levelChart read Skill/Skill/Lissandra/Lissandra/Lissandra/Azir/Lissandra.
audit.why: Content layer matches the packet chart, so the full layer is the stale one. Difficulty is early-even, Lissandra-favoured 3 through 5 while Shifting Sands (22s at rank 1) is the only escape from a 450-range root, Azir-favoured at his first item once Emperor's Divide (120s) is online, then Lissandra again with two items of point-and-click lockdown.
audit.corrected: phases[].side realigned to the content/packet chart as one atomic group, with the whys rewritten so no row argues with its own sentence.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text and whys[5] both called Azir's ultimate 'Shurima Shuffle'.
audit.why: Riot's name for the R is Emperor's Divide; Shurima Shuffle is a player nickname for the E-flash-R combo, not an ability.
audit.corrected: Real name used, with the 120/105/90 cooldown attached so the spike is a schedulable window.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never stated the decisive interaction: Shifting Sands (E) both shields Azir and is his only way out of Lissandra's 450-range W root, and it is on 22/20.5/19/17.5/16.
audit.why: Brief's missingInteractions flags shield-absorbs-burst; the packet defect flags that no Azir ability is ever named. Lissandra's kill pattern is E-in, W-root, R-tomb, all of which land only if the dash is already spent.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field, Do's and Don'ts, enemyWin and carry all now key off the Shifting Sands downtime with real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all (lintFindings COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: It is the field that exists to hold real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Shifting Sands 22s to 16s, Emperor's Divide 120s, Frozen Tomb 120s now stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was the tradeBad string verbatim, both under unrelated titles (lintFindings COPY_PASTE_BLEED). dosFull[0].d and dosFull[2].d also carried bodies unrelated to their titles.
audit.why: The title promises one thing and the body explains another.
audit.corrected: All four bullet bodies rewritten to match their own titles, grounded in Azir's ranges and cooldowns.

edits.before: Q-shatter the wave and chip his melee step-ups — your early Q harass is better than the lane gives it credit for.
edits.after: Even start: he last-hits with one soldier from range, you Q-shatter the wave — neither of you can punish the other yet.

edits.before: E claw completes the kit — you now have the lane's strangest engage and a guaranteed exit. Greed carefully; the claw is slow.
edits.after: E claw completes the kit and Shifting Sands is 22s at rank 1 — inside that gap he cannot leave your W root. This is your level.

edits.before: Malignance spike: your R comes back absurdly fast and every tomb chains into the slow field. Force picks with E-W-R.
edits.after: His first-item spike: Emperor's Divide is up on 120s and can knock you off him or wall your claw exit mid-commit.

edits.before: - Azir Shifting Sands: matchup-defining — His shield-dash to a soldier — engage the window after he burns it. It governs your forward steps. - R Frozen Tomb (self-cast) spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Shifting Sands (E) is 22s at rank 1, 16s at rank 5, and it is both his shield and his only exit — step in after he burns it. - Emperor's Divide is 120s at rank 1. - Frozen Tomb self-cast spent on poke is a death you scheduled; hold the 120s for a fight that decides something.

edits.before: His shield-dash to a soldier — engage the window after he burns it. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: Soldiers last-hit for him from 525 range, so your Q shards clip wave and soldier line while he stands back.

edits.before: Q-shatter his wave contact, and when he steps to punish, W-root into full rotation and walk — the root tax makes every aggressive step expensive.
edits.after: One window per cycle: claw in only after Shifting Sands is spent, because for the next 16-22s he has no dash out of your 450-range W root.

edits.before: Azir spends Shifting Sands early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Inside 450 units he has no soldiers stacked — root him, then tomb before he can re-dash out.

edits.before: Clawing in with W on cooldown 'to poke' — an engage tool spent on chip damage is a Lissandra standing in melee range with no ice left.
edits.after: Self-R burns the answer to Emperor's Divide and to his dive — eat the soldier chip and keep the 120s ultimate for a commit.

edits.before: Azir wins by landing Shifting Sands, denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Azir wins by farming behind soldiers at 740 range, dashing clear of your W, and splitting you off with Emperor's Divide.

edits.before: Carry through picks — claw-root-tomb converts vision into kills better than any control mage; the map shrinks every time your E is up.
edits.after: Carry by catching Azir off his soldiers — claw-root-tomb beats a champion whose only escape is a 16-22s dash to a summon you can see.

edits.before: Ahead, hunt: claw into every river skirmish first, tomb the carry, and snowball picks — Azir farming under tower can't stop a roaming Lissandra.
edits.after: Ahead, hunt his soldier line: claw in the second Shifting Sands is down, root and tomb him, and take mid tower before his Disc of the Sun matters.

edits.before: This is Azir's one strong window: his Shurima Shuffle (R) can wall you off or knock you back mid-engage, so respect the flag-dash all-in when his ult is up.
edits.after: This is Azir's one strong window: Emperor's Divide (120s at rank 1) walls you off or knocks you back mid-engage, so respect the Shifting-Sands-into-ult all-in while it is up.

edits.before: First item is Azir's spike: his Shurima Shuffle can wall or knock you away to reset the fight.
edits.after: First item is Azir's spike: Emperor's Divide can wall or knock you away to reset the fight.

notes: Chart: content win[0..6] and packet.levelChart already agreed (Skill/Skill/Lissandra/Lissandra/Lissandra/Azir/Lissandra); only the full-layer phases[].side was stale, so all seven sides were moved to match as one atomic group and no win[N] edits were needed (a paired edit would have had before==after). Whys rewritten on every row whose verdict actually changed direction. Left phases[].rating alone — no verifiable basis in the brief for re-rating. Not asserted: whether Lissandra's self-R untargetability dodges the Emperor's Divide knockback, or whether Shifting Sands' shield eats the Frozen Tomb damage — neither is in Riot's text and the kit's needsResearch is empty by design.
